episodes.id: fr-FR-Le journal du matin, mardi 24 novembre
episodes.title: Le journal du matin, mardi 24 novembre
episodes.headline_en: French savers have withdrawn nearly 10 billion euros from their Livrets A since January, franceinfo and Le Monde report; franceinfo says it is the savings account's worst year since 2008
summary_en: French savers have withdrawn nearly 10 billion euros from their Livrets A since January, franceinfo and Le Monde report; franceinfo says it is the savings account's worst year since 2008
Nvidia, the American chipmaker, has reinstated its chief executive Jensen Huang, eleven days after he was removed, under pressure from Donald Trump according to Le Monde and Libération
The Elysée announces that France will build strategic stocks of rare earths and priority metals, franceinfo reports

episodes.title: Le sport, mardi 24 novembre
episodes.headline_en: RC Lens play at Leipzig on Tuesday evening in the Champions League, franceinfo and L'Équipe say; kick-off is at nine o'clock tonight, Ouest-France and L'Équipe write
summary_en: RC Lens play at Leipzig on Tuesday evening in the Champions League, franceinfo and L'Équipe say; kick-off is at nine o'clock tonight, Ouest-France and L'Équipe write
Stellantis ends its factory motorsport programmes, Ouest-France and L'Équipe write: Peugeot in endurance, then Citroën and Opel in Formula E in the summer of 2027

episodes.title: La météo, mardi 24 novembre
episodes.headline_en: Marseille today: overcast, 8 to 16 degrees, wind up to 21 km/h, per the Météo-France models
summary_en: Marseille today: overcast, 8 to 16 degrees, wind up to 21 km/h, per the Météo-France models
